appContext.summary: Milni is a wedding companion app: guests get the schedule, directions, announcements, chat and a shared photo gallery for one wedding; hosts plan the whole weekend and welcome guests. A second wedding can be switched to from the same app.

theme.style: Luxe editorial wedding magazine world of ivory silk, gold-veined white marble, soft champagne drapery and hazy golden-hour sunset beaches. Backgrounds are light, airy and calm, with warm diffused daylight, gentle film grain and delicate gold-leaf glints. The upper third stays pale ivory so dark-ink italic headlines read clearly. The mood is romantic, refined and quietly opulent, never loud.
theme.headlineFont: font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; color: #2A2420; text-align: center; @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@1,500;1,600&display=swap');
